title: Expression of Interest: Placement Matching Specialist
description:
About Virtual InternshipsWe're on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.
$14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to "Escape To in 2023"Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies
One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to "try before you apply" by visiting our VI-P Guide, which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are
Your RoleAt Virtual Internships, Placement Matching Specialists (PMS) are at the heart of what we do: connecting students from around the world with real, career-building remote internships.
This Expression of Interest is ideally for early-career people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and be stretched in the right way. The PMS role is a proven launchpad at VI: a high-learning, high-support environment where many people build their core skills before growing into other teams across the company within ~1-1.5 years.
If you're motivated by challenge, impact, and growth - this role is designed for you.
What You'll Be DoingAs a Placement Matching Specialist, you'll join our fast-moving Placements Team and take ownership of matching interns with global host companies across industries and time zones.
You'll work hands-on with real placements, real stakeholders, and real outcomes — learning how to communicate clearly, influence decisions, and manage complexity at pace. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
Matching interns with suitable host companies and securing placement opportunities
Leading conversations with companies to present candidates and guide decisions
Following up consistently to keep placements moving and overcome delays
Managing multiple placements at once while staying organised and focused
Keeping systems and admin up to date so every placement runs smoothly
You'll never be left to figure things out alone — but you will be trusted to own your work and grow quickly.
Why This Role Is a LaunchpadThe PM role is one of the fastest learning roles at Virtual Internships. In a short time, you'll develop:
Confidence in professional communication and persuasion
Strong judgement through real, hands-on decision-making
The ability to manage multiple priorities without feeling overwhelmed
Ownership, resilience, and comfort working in a global, fast-paced startup environment
Many of our team members started their VI journey as PMS and have since grown into other roles across the organisation, including:
Greta, now our Head of Pre-Internship
Raksha, now our Placement Enablement Manager
Helen, now our Placement Readiness Specialist
Chi, now our Talent Acquisition Lead
The common thread? The skills they built as PMS shaped everything that came next.
Who We're Looking For
Your Attributes
You take responsibility and follow things through
You're curious, coachable, and eager to improve
You stay calm when things move fast and priorities shift
You communicate clearly and confidently in English
You're excited by learning, growth, and meaningful work

title: Security Specialist
description:
Who Are We?
Decentralized Masters is at the forefront of DeFi education globally. In just two years, we have grown from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 140 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
Our Impact
While our growth has been remarkable, we take even greater pride in the success of our clients. To date, we have empowered over 4000 investors to break into the DeFi world. At Decentralized Masters, we don't just offer education; we cultivate a powerhouse of knowledge combined with an engaging community, innovative technology, and a team of leading DeFi and blockchain experts. Our commitment is to deliver unparalleled resources designed for long-term success in the world of DeFi and Web3, ensuring our members not only safeguard but also enhance their financial future.
Our Vision
Our goal is to create the largest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen, starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education. This vision is ambitious, transformative, and poised to change the landscape of digital finance.
Are You Ready?
This is more than just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of Web3 technology and education. Are you ready to be part of our vision to redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond? Apply below, and let's explore this journey together.
Check us out here:
What will you be doing?
We're looking for a hungry, junior security professional whose default instinct is to attack first, patch second. This isn't a governance-and-policy desk job. You'll spend your days trying to break into our own systems, finding the cracks before anyone else does, and then relentlessly closing them.
If your idea of a good day is discovering a misconfigured S3 bucket, popping a shell on a test environment, and writing up the fix before lunch read on.
Break things (on purpose):
Continuously run penetration tests against our web apps, APIs, internal tools, and cloud infrastructure
Conduct phishing simulations and social engineering tests against our own team
Perform recon, enumeration, and exploitation attempts on our systems in a controlled, authorized way
Hunt for vulnerabilities before real attackers do - then document and escalate them
Harden everything you find:
Work directly with engineering to remediate vulnerabilities you uncover
Tighten cloud security configurations (AWS) - IAM policies, exposed services, secrets management
Review access controls and flag over-privileged accounts, then drive least-privilege fixes
Implement and tune monitoring tools (SIEM, IDS/IPS) so we catch anything that slips through
Keep the lights on:
Assist with incident detection and response when real events occur
Help maintain audit logs and ensure we have visibility across our systems
Support compliance work (GDPR, SOC 2) as it relates to technical controls
Requirements
What You Will Bring
Must-have:
1–2 years of experience in security, pentesting, bug bounty, or a related hands-on role (or equivalent self-taught experience with proof)
Demonstrable ability to find and exploit common vulnerabilities - OWASP Top 10, misconfigurations, broken access controls
Basic cloud security knowledge (AWS preferred) - you know what "public S3 bucket" means and why it's bad
Comfortable using tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, or similar
Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and how to think like a threat actor
You document your findings clearly - written reports matter as much as the exploit
Nice-to-have:
CTF experience or an active HackTheBox / TryHackMe profile
Any security certifications: eJPT, CEH, Security+, OSCP (in progress counts)
Scripting ability in Python or Bash to automate recon or testing
Interest or background in DeFi, crypto, or Web3 security
Familiarity with smart contract attack vectors (a big bonus)
Benefits
What We Offer
Competitive salary
Fully remote - work from anywhere
Unlimited PTO and flexible schedule
Team off-sites and events
A genuine mandate to break our stuff and make us stronger for it
Ready to hack with purpose?
If you've been sharpening your skills on bug bounties, CTFs, or homelab environments and want your first real shot at doing this professionally — we want to hear from you. Show us what you've found, what you've broken, and how you fixed it.

Responsibilities2. Client-Centric Communication & Education3. Performance Analysis & HandoffDay-today Activities

Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them

Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic
Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.
External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals
Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.

How this role fits into the organization: This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company's success.
Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk
The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor
Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation

Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations
Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus
Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly
Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball
Nice to Have:
Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
Understands coding and has a strong tech background
Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

title: Agente Educacional
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA
A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável, principalmente, pela operação do fluxo de entrada e saída de alunos, bem como das rotinas escolares e orientação de convivência escolar. Deve ser uma pessoa proativa, organizada, resiliente, cordial, ter facilidade em se comunicar e se relacionar com jovens e adultos e ser capaz de lidar com o ambiente dinâmico de uma escola.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS
O que você fará:

  • Receber e registrar a entrada e saída de alunos, responsáveis e visitantes, garantindo o controle de acesso e a segurança no ambiente escolar;
  • Zelar pela boa convivência e harmonia entre os membros da comunidade escolar, intervindo quando necessário para resolver conflitos e promover um clima positivo;
  • Organizar e supervisionar os diversos setores da escola, assegurando que as instalações estejam em boas condições, ordenadas e propícias ao aprendizado;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros setores da escola, garantindo a comunicação e ações coordenadas para o bom funcionamento das atividades educacionais e administrativas;
  • Executar tarefas adicionais de natureza similar e complexidade, de acordo com as demandas da escola e sob a orientação da liderança;
  • Seguir e aplicar os valores, diretrizes e procedimentos estabelecidos pela Escola, promovendo a adesão à cultura organizacional;
  • Priorizar a segurança e bem-estar dos alunos, tomando medidas para garantir um ambiente livre de riscos e perigos;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar parceiros e alunos envolvidos em atividades extracurriculares, garantindo que todas as atividades estejam alinhadas com os padrões de segurança e comportamento esperados;
  • Organizar, executar e viabilizar a logística de eventos escolares que podem ocorrer em alguns sábados letivos.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas;
  • Simplicidade e qualidade na realização de tarefas;
  • Boa comunicação e gosto por trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade;
  • Organização;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Entusiasmo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência lidando diretamente com jovens e adolescentes.

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

title: Expert Network Project Coordinator
description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we've seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to continued growth, we are hiring for an Expert Network Project Coordinator at M3 Global Research, an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:  

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors. 

Job Description

The Expert Network Project Coordinator assists the Client Service team with day-to-day management of market research studies, to ensure all projects successfully complete on time, within the budget and in accordance with the client specs, while meeting and exceeding client expectations.

This position is one of the key team members in the execution of the quantitative/qualitative projects, and is responsible for field management and sample strategies, and will be accountable for coordinating with respondents, vendors, and clients. They will assist with the set-up of the study and other project requirements as needed.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Manage and control sampling and fieldwork, including screener review for allocated projects.
  • Execute end to end project related tasks which could include (but not exclusively) link setup, link testing, languages requests, desk research, quality/audit checks, set up and delivery of study invitations, manage exclusion lists, M3 Wallet approvals, invoicing and cost reconciliation.
  • Address Support Team and other stakeholders' requests in a timely manner.
  • Attend meetings with PMs regarding assigned projects to ensure project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities are understood.
  • Takes notes and fill checklists during key meetings and share them with the attendee afterwards
  • Host market research pretest/pilot interviews for clients, and ensure interviews are conducted on time and as planned. This will require direct client interactions.
  • Build, update and track customized fielding plans for all projects as needed.
  • Proactively seek alternative fieldwork strategies and find solutions to address response rates and costs on each project.
  • Manage and control of the partners on quantitative projects throughout the life cycle of the project, ensuring that M3 achieves and exceeds client's expectations.
  • Track, monitor and report on sampling performance.
  • Support PMs with invoicing ensuring that projects are closed and ready for invoicing in a timely manner.
  • Alert the Project Manager of a project when a fieldwork strategy is failing or getting off track or there is a quality concern and work together to find alternative solutions.
  • Design and request multichannel recruitment methodologies for allocated projects, which could include (but not exclusively) email campaigns, calling, desk research, text messages, online advertisement, referral schemes, forums, blogs, patient groups and associations networking and social media.
  • Scheduling respondents for market research interviews, including creating the scheduler in the system, communication with respondents, coordinating shared moderator schedules, manual entry in MR system and moderator scheduling platforms.
  • Help respondents log in to qualitative platforms for their interviews and troubleshoot any issues.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated knowledge of English grammar rules
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel) and quick learner of new technologies/software
  • Must have basic math skills, with the ability to calculate incidence rate, response rates profit, etc
  • Interest / natural curiosity or previous experience /exposure within the healthcare space
  • Exhibit strong critical thinking skills and take initiative to improve skills and troubleshoot proactively with PM using all available resources to support project success
  • Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives
  • Self-motivated and able to (re)prioritize tasks throughout the workday
  • Exceptional time management, organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to multitask
  • Fluent in English

Additional Information

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

This position will support US EST Hours 

We kindly ask that you please submit all resumes in English.

description:
Welcome to the good side of tech
You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?
Docplanner at scale
We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.
How does Docplanner Tech fit here?
At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.
We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you'd like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here's a video of us.
And why should you join us?
Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.
We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We're not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.
Job Description
Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.
We are looking for a Product Designer for software modernization who will be responsible for creating and improving user interfaces, from research and ideation to final delivery, focusing on usability and user experience. This professional will work on the conception of digital products, prototyping, testing, and iterating solutions, always seeking to enhance the interaction between the user and technology. They will also work in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with developers and Product Managers to ensure product quality and efficiency.

Collaboration: Work closely with product, development, and other teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
Continuous optimization: Monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and propose solutions to optimize the user experience.

Skills:

Portfolio demonstrating product design skills.

title: Especialista de Operações
description:
Descrição da vaga
Por que trabalhar conosco?
Porque somos a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão em prática fazendo a diferença nos 178 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.
A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Apoiar nos projetos de abastecimento de água e transporte de esgoto;
Identificar gargalos e propor soluções de melhorias de maneira rápida e eficiente;
Manter interface do COI com a unidade de negócio e com os outros setores (apoio com modelagem, TI, perdas, comunicação, despacho e serviços);
Apoiar a unidade de negócio nos eventos, seja na busca pela causa raiz ou na organização do evento;
Garantir que o time interno entenda e conheça o abastecimento de cada unidade de negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino superior completo Engenharia ou áreas afins;
Pacote Office avançado, com ênfase em Excel;
Desejável conhecimento de Power BI e Qgis;
Conhecimentos Técnicos de Hidráulica de redes pressurizadas.
Conhecimentos Técnicos de Sistemas de abastecimento de água.
Técnicas de pitometria.
Habilidade de Leitura e interpretação de curvas de perda de carga.
Instrumentação de campo (medidores de vazão, pressão, dataloggers).
Conhecimeto de Softwares de modelagem hidráulica (EPANET, InfoWater, WaterGEMS).
Noções de GIS.

  • Liderar a estratégia de Gestão de Mudança da transformação SAP, abrangendo comunicação, engajamento, readiness, treinamento e gestão de impactos organizacionais.
  • Realizar diagnósticos de maturidade e análises de impacto (OIA – Organizational Impact Assessment) para identificar gaps comportamentais, operacionais e culturais.
  • Preparar e conduzir rituais executivos, Steering Committees e touchpoints com áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento entre C-Level, PMO, TI e frentes funcionais SAP.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de comunicação multicanal, traduzindo temas técnicos SAP para mensagens claras, pragmáticas e orientadas ao negócio.
  • Estruturar e gerir o plano de treinamento SAP (Training Strategy, TNA – Training Needs Assessment, cronograma e execução), assegurando aderência ao modelo de rollout.
  • Liderar a gestão da mudança durante cutover e hiper-care, garantindo readiness da organização, mitigação de riscos e aderência ao novo operating model.
  • Atuar como ponte entre as equipes funcionais SAP (Financeiro, Logística, IS-U, etc.) e as áreas de negócio na interpretação dos impactos dos novos processos.
  • Elaborar dashboards executivos de Change Management, KPIs e indicadores de adoção.
  • Garantir alinhamento às metodologias internas (SAP Activate, Clean Core, TAO quando aplicável) e melhores práticas globais de GMO.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em Gestão de Mudança para projetos SAP, em fases de implementação, rollout ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Senioridade para atuar em ambientes complexos, multigeográficos e politicamente sensíveis.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação executiva, com narrativa clara e estruturação de mensagens estratégicas.
  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol para condução de workshops, reports e governança multinacional.
  • Vivência com frameworks de Change Management (ADKAR, Prosci, Kotter, etc.), combinados com práticas de transformação digital.
  • Experiência em gestão de stakeholders e condução de rituais executivos em grandes organizações.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas tecnológicos em impactos de negócio e comportamentais.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação em programas de transformação multinacionais ou multicountry rollouts.
  • Background híbrido (Processos, PMO, Comunicação Interna, Treinamento, Cultura).

title: Executivo(a) Key Account
description:
Nosso modo de fazer no time


Transforme sua carreira com o iFood Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário

  • Gestão 360º de Contas (General Management): Liderar o plano estratégico (Joint Business Plan) dos maiores parceiros do canal, influenciando desde a operação em loja e integração técnica até o sortimento de produtos e pricing.
  • Visão de Canal: Atuar com foco macro, garantindo que as estratégias aplicadas na sua carteira gerem valor e sirvam de benchmark para todo o ecossistema.
  • Análise de Dados e IA: Interpretar grandes volumes de dados para gerar insights de negócios. Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para otimizar processos, criar discussões de alto nível com parceiros e prever tendências de consumo.
  • Rentabilização e Alavancas: Gerir budgets de investimento, negociar exclusividades e garantir a rentabilidade da carteira através da venda consultiva de produtos do ecossistema iFood.
  • Interface Estratégica: Conectar-se com diretores e stakeholders seniores para alinhar prioridades e reportar o desempenho nacional do canal.
  • Liderança e Protagonismo de Categoria: Atuar com mindset de liderança, assumindo a frente das discussões estratégicas do canal. Ser a referência técnica e de negócios para o time, influenciando a estratégia da categoria muito além da sua própria carteira.

Ingredientes que buscamos

  • Formação: Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil Empreendedor: Mentalidade de "donos do negócio", proatividade para resolver problemas complexos e visão de futuro.
  • Forte Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade avançada para interpretar dados, criar diagnósticos e transformá-los em planos de ação (Storytelling com dados).
  • Negociação Consultiva de Alto Nível: Experiência em lidar com interlocutores de grandes redes.
  • Adaptabilidade e Velocidade: Conforto para trabalhar em um ambiente de escala e inovação constante.
  • Comunicação e Relações Interpessoais: Habilidade excepcional de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de adaptar o discurso para diferentes públicos.
  • Experiência: Sólida trajetória em Gestão de Grandes Contas (Key Account Management), Gestão de Categoria ou Gerência de Produto/Trade no varejo.
  • Ferramentas: Domínio de Excel (avançado), ferramentas de BI (Power BI/Looker) e familiaridade com ferramentas de produtividade (Slack/Salesforce).
  • Background no Setor: Experiência prévia em grandes players do mercado (Varejo ou Indústria) ou grandes Marketplaces.
  • Familiaridade com IA: Conhecimento em aplicação de agentes de IA ou automação de processos analíticos.

Sobre nós


No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. title: Cozinheiro - Marítimo
description:
Bem-vindos a Bordo,

Aqui na Log-In somos um time formado por pessoas disruptivas, engajadas e apaixonadas que gerenciam e operam as melhores soluções para a movimentação de cargas por meio da cabotagem, complementada por ponta rodoviária.

Hoje somos mais de 1.000 corações que se destacam por unirem valores que inspiram a companhia. Por aqui, os valores são as diretrizes que traduzem aquilo em que acreditamos, que são: simplicidade, atitude de dono, espirito de equipe, cliente no centro, segurança e foco em resultados.

Nossa cultura e o cuidado com a nossa gente nos transporta para posicionamentos ainda mais diversos, equitativos e inclusivos. O resultado de toda nossa dedicação é refletido em pesquisas de clima realizadas com nossos colaboradores. Em 2022, a Log-In conquistou, pelo segundo ano consecutivo, o selo de Great Place to Work(GPTW). No mesmo ano, entramos no Ranking GPTW de melhores empresas para trabalhar do Espírito Santo e, em 2023, no Ranking de melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio de Janeiro.

Uma conquista que nos orgulha e nos incentiva a continuar fazendo de tudo para ser um lugar cada vez melhor para as pessoas.

Nossa jornada também é marcada pela inovação, responsabilidade e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time. Será um prazer ter você aqui com a gente

Responsabilidades e atribuições

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


Ao Cozinheiro compete:

  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir todas as ordens ou determinações que receber dos seus superiores, relativas aos serviços de sua especialidade;
  • Responder pelo rancho em serviço diário de cozinha, esmerando-se para que o seu preparo seja feito o mais higiênico e escrupulosamente possível;
  • Fiscalizar os gêneros entregues na cozinha, providenciando o seu transporte, guarda e conservação;
  • Dirigir pessoalmente a distribuição dos alimentos durante as refeições;
  • Zelar pela conservação, limpeza e asseio de todas as dependências da cozinha, bem como dos utensílios;
  • Usar e exigir que os demais usem, igualmente, a indumentária apropriada e uniformes apropriados aos serviços culinários, mantendo-a sempre limpa e asseada;
  • Comunicar ao Comandante toda e qualquer suspeita acerca do seu estado de saúde e de seus auxiliares, como também toda e qualquer falta disciplinar acorrida;
  • Assinar cautelas de responsabilidade do material entregue para os serviços de suas atribuições responsabilizando-se pelas faltas ocorridas;
  • Executar as fainas gerais de limpeza da cozinha e dos demais utensílios;
  • Executar o transporte de gêneros do paiol e câmaras frigoríficas para a cozinha;
  • Apresentar-se ao Imediato após o término diário dos serviços, a fim de receber ordens para o dia seguinte;
  • Comunicar ao Imediato toda e qualquer anormalidade verificada nos serviços que lhe estão afetos.
  • Manter devidamente conservados, limpos e em ótimas condições de higiene os paióis de mantimentos, câmaras frigoríficas e suas dependências e geladeiras;
  • Receber, controlar e guardar todos os gêneros destinados ao abastecimento da embarcação, fazendo a sua arrumação nos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas ou geladeiras, de modo a evitar qualquer deterioração;
  • Fazer a saída, diariamente e de acordo com o cardápio, dos gêneros secos e frescos, destinados ao preparo da alimentação, verificando o estado de conservação dos mesmos, pesando-os e conferindo-os;
  • Não permitir, terminantemente, que se fume nos paióis, câmaras ou antecâmaras frigoríficas;
  • Providenciar para que a carne arrumada nas câmaras frigoríficas ou geladeiras não fique em contato com peixes, nem estivada englobadamente, devendo ficar separada uma parte da outra, de modo a permitir a livre circulação entre elas;
  • Receber e entregar ao Comandante, após conferidas as validades, a qualidade, o número, peso e espécie, as notas de entrega de gêneros;
  • Proceder o balanço dos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas, sempre que lhe for determinado;
  • Comunicar aos seus superiores quaisquer irregularidades ou ocorrências que se verificar nos serviços a seu cargo, bem como mantê-los sempre a par do movimento e funcionamento dos paióis e câmaras frigoríficas;
  • Ter sob sua guarda e responsabilidade de todas as andainas de roupas de cama da embarcação, toalhas de mesa, pratos, panelas e talheres.
  • Não fornecer qualquer material ou gênero sem ordem específica.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • CIR (Caderneta de Inscrição e Registro);
  • Regra: MLC;
  • TBS;
  • Proteção em Navios (Combate a Pirataria) - EBCP;
  • Certificados NRs - Atualizados ( NR-6 / NR-20 / ANVISA RDC-216 |
  • Toda certificação em dia;
  • Experiência em navios.

Informações adicionais

title: Analista de TI Sênior
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.
Estamos com 1 vaga de Analista de TI Sênior, com foco em Administração de Redes. Confira os detalhes abaixo:
FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA
Necessário Superior completo em Engenharia de Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Certificações desejáveis: CCNA, CCNP, Fortinet NSE, CompTIA Network+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Network Engineer Associate.
Desejável pós-graduação em Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação ou Engenharia de Conectividade.
EXPERIÊNCIA/CONHECIMENTOS
Imprescindível experiência em administração e suporte de redes corporativas LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud;
Conhecimento avançado em roteamento, switching, firewalls, NAT, VLANs, QoS e VPNs;
Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e automação de rede (Zabbix, SolarWinds, PRTG, Ansible);
Experiência em ambientes híbridos e multicloud, com integração entre redes locais e provedores cloud;
Conhecimento de protocolos de rede (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, BGP, OSPF);
Familiaridade com segurança de rede, criptografia, IDS/IPS, segmentação e controle de acesso;
Capacidade de diagnóstico e troubleshooting de incidentes complexos de conectividade;
Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e regulados, com requisitos de alta disponibilidade e compliance;
Familiaridade com soluções de rede e segurança Cisco, Palo Alto e Trend Micro;
Necessário Inglês técnico intermediário (para leitura de documentação e interface com fornecedores globais).
MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO
Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.
Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
Gestão e Operação de Ambientes
Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.
Implementação e Melhoria Contínua
Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.
Segurança, Governança e Compliance
Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.
BENEFÍCIOS
Assistência médica
Assistência odontológica
Auxílio creche
Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
Previdência privada
Seguro de vida
Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição

title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst
Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.
The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.
Key Responsibilities
Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;
Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;
Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;
Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;
Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;
Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;
Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;
Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;
Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;
Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;
Control operational activities related to personnel departure, mobilization, and allocation.
Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field;
Previous experience in offshore operations, oil & gas, or maritime environment preferred;
Experience managing training matrices and certification control systems (DRAKE knowledge is an advantage);
Knowledge of Brazilian labor and maritime regulations is desirable;
Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities;
Proactive profile with strong interface capability between HR and Operations.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances;
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, no co-pay);
Life Insurance;
Annual Bonus;
Private Pension Plan;
Childcare Allowance.
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Coordenador de SDR
description:
Descrição da empresa

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?
Somos a Doctoralia, empresa do grupo Docplanner, e estamos presentes em 13 países, sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês
Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.
Ajudando as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis
Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos: marketplace, que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online. Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.Na Doctoralia, buscamos um(a) líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas inbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional

Descrição do emprego

Na Doctoralia, buscamos um líder com energia, visão estratégica e forte orientação por dados para coordenar nosso time de pré-vendas outbound. A pessoa será responsável por garantir a eficiência da jornada dos nossos leads, com foco em performance e excelência operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar um time de 4 a 6 SDRs, promovendo desenvolvimento contínuo e foco em alta performance;
  • Garantir a eficiência da operação outbound, desde o lead MQL até a qualificação e agendamento de reuniões;
  • Monitorar indicadores críticos como conversão, tempo de resposta, volume por canal e no-show;
  • Revisar fluxos de cadência, roteiros e abordagens de contato, propondo melhorias com base em dados;
  • Realizar escutas, feedbacks, treinamentos e roleplays com o time;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica com Marketing, Vendas e áreas de suporte para otimizar o funil de qualificação;
  • Propor melhorias de processos e fluxos comerciais, com base em dados e performance do time;
  • Garantir a integração e evolução dos novos SDRs, fortalecendo cultura de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Ser ponte entre o time de pré-vendas e demais áreas, como Marketing, Vendas e Operações;
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Salesforce e Outreach para gestão de performance e automação.

Você vai se conectar com...

  • Gerente de Pré-Vendas (liderança direta)
  • Executivos de Vendas, Marketing, RevOps e TA
  • Outras lideranças da área comercial

Qualificações

O que buscamos

  • Experiência sólida com liderança de times SDR ou vendas;
  • Vivência prática liderado times em operações outbound B2B;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com base em dados;
  • Boa comunicação, poder de influência e espírito de colaboração;
  • Conhecimento em CRM e ferramentas de automação (Salesforce, Outreach, etc.);
  • Formação superior completa.

Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Já ter atuado como SDR antes de assumir a liderança;
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS, tech ou startups;
  • Ter estruturado processos de pré-vendas do zero;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Etapas do processo seletivo

  1. Triagem de currículos - analisamos seu perfil com base nos requisitos da vaga e no momento atual da área.
  2. Entrevista com Talent Acquisition (por vídeo) - bate-papo por vídeo com nosso time de Recrutamento para conhecer suas experiências, avaliar competências e entender o fit com a cultura. Também é sua oportunidade de tirar dúvidas e conhecer mais sobre a empresa
  3. Avaliação Comportamental - aplicamos um teste rápido (5 a 7 min) que nos ajuda a entender melhor seu perfil comportamental.
  4. Entrevista com a Liderança - conversa mais aprofundada com sua liderança direta. Avaliamos aspectos técnicos, expectativas e seguimos aprofundando o alinhamento com a vaga.
  5. Entrevista presencial na nossa sede + Case prático / Teste técnico - etapa final Um momento para demonstrar sua forma de pensar e tomar decisões na prática.

  6. Oferta e início imediato - Tudo certo? Seguimos com a proposta formal e, após a sua aprovação, você já poderá iniciar com a gente

Em todas as etapas fornecemos o feedback do processo.

Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

title: CRO Expert
description:
Company Introduction:

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth.

With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods.

If you're looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About the Role 

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients' websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates. 

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented. 

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients' e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency's clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients' websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands' landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position specifications:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month
Requirements

About You:

Profile:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients' CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape.

Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key requirements:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position has the following key requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user's experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • Strong communication skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? O/A Operador(a) de Produção (Vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com deficiência) será responsável por operar equipamentos de fabricação, embalagem ou pesagem das áreas produtivas, seguindo normas e procedimentos da empresa.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Suportar outros operadores e times de produção.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Desejável conhecimento anterior com operação de equipamentos fabris, em especial em indústria farmacêutica, alimentícia, cosméticos ou química;
  • Desejável curso técnico;
  • Desejável conhecimento em processos de melhoria contínua: TPM, Lean, Kaizen, 5S.

O que oferecemos:

  • Oportunidade sem precedentes de tomar a saúde diária mais acessível, inclusiva e sustentável ao fazer parte de uma empresa global.
  • Fazer parte de uma companhia que é certificada como Top Employer, sendo reconhecida pela excelência em suas práticas de RH e gestão.
  • Trabalhar com marcars incríveis, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Eno, entre outras
  • Crescimento contínuo para alcançar seu máximo potencial.
  • Experiências únicas ao trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza a saúde e o bem-estar das pessoas e permite que cada um seja sua melhor versão.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time

Na Haleon, vamos além das expectativas e impulsionamos uma cultura em que fazemos o que mais importa. Promovemos um ambiente onde a diversidade seja celebrada, a equidade seja praticada e a inclusão seja vivenciada.
Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando à individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Dados Pleno, com forte domínio técnico e perfil analítico, para atuar na construção de soluções de dados, automação de processos e desenvolvimento de dashboards estratégicos e interativos, apoiando a tomada de decisão do negócio por meio de dados confiáveis e bem estruturados.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental na extração, tratamento, modelagem e visualização de dados, além da criação de relatórios automatizados para diferentes áreas da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar extração, tratamento e transformação de dados utilizando SQL e processos de ETL
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards estratégicos, interativos e relatórios automatizados
  • Atuar na modelagem de dados, garantindo consistência, qualidade e performance
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Tableau e Looker Studio
  • Automatizar processos de coleta, atualização e entrega de dados
  • Apoiar áreas internas com análises exploratórias, indicadores e insights estratégicos
  • Garantir boas práticas de governança, organização e documentação dos dados
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de tecnologia, produto e negócio

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados (nível Pleno)
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL
  • Experiência com ETL e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados
  • Domínio em Power BI e experiência com Tableau e/ou Looker Studio
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de interpretação de dados
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados em informações claras para o negócio

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com automação de processos de dados
  • Vivência com ambientes de BI, Analytics ou Data Driven
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Python ou R
  • Experiência com cloud (BigQuery, AWS, Azure, etc.)

Escolaridade Mínima: Ensino Superior

title: Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
To ensure a fair and efficient hiring process, candidates should not contact UN/COMMON employees directly regarding this role. Applications and communication must occur through the official application process.
UN/COMMON is a digital experience and marketing agency that launches and grows the world's best emerging brands. We believe the future of consumer-facing brands starts with creating authentic stories built for the consumer first and brand second. We are extremely proud to work with revolutionary brands such as Selena Gomez's Rare Beauty, Dermalogica, Liquid Death, Lemon Perfect, and more.

We are an employee and customer-centric agency bringing mission first brand stories to life to benefit the greater good and better people's lives. And we have a TON of fun doing it

The Retention Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of email and SMS production for our clients. This includes project management, content planning, copy and creative briefs, HTML builds, QA, and scheduling. You will manage end-to-end production and keep timelines on track across design, strategy, and client teams. You will work closely with a Retention Marketing Strategist to support retention strategy, reporting, and ongoing optimization. If you enjoy organized workflows, sharp deadlines, clean builds, and improving the customer journey through thoughtful messaging, you will do well here.

What You Will Do

You will manage the full production process for email campaigns and automated flows, build emails in Klaviyo or similar ESPs, write on-brand copy, create clear briefs for the design team, QA content and logic, and schedule deployments. You will maintain the monthly content calendar, drive timelines with clients, and ensure all assets and approvals stay on track. You will support the Retention Marketing Strategist by pulling performance data, analyzing results, and developing recommendations. You will build automated workflows, segmentation, and list logic, maintain list hygiene, and work confidently with Shopify apps such as Yotpo, Loyalty Lion, JustUno, and Privy.

Based on our projected customer base growth, we foresee the need for a  Retention Marketing Specialist  within the next 2-4 months to ensure we can effectively manage and nurture our expanding user community.

Requirements

What You Need

  • 2 years of experience in retention marketing, specifically across email, SMS, CRM, or loyalty programs.
  • Hands-on experience with an Email Service Platform (ESP), with a strong preference for Klaviyo.
  • Strong copywriting skills for direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce, with the ability to adapt tone and style to match different client brands.
  • A solid understanding of email analytics and the ability to translate data insights into actionable strategy.
  • Clear understanding of the difference between marketing campaigns and automated flows, and knowing when to deploy each.
  • Proficiency in building segmented customer lists using behavioral and transactional data.
  • Experience working within Shopify or directly supporting Shopify-based clients.
  • A proactive, organized approach, with the ability to think through the entire customer journey and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative team.

What Success Looks Like

Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. Email and SMS performance improves because of your quality and attention to detail. Strategy and reporting move faster because you stay ahead of data and execution. You keep projects aligned, informed, and on schedule. You take ownership, ask smart questions, and keep work moving forward.

Benefits

This is a contract position
Up to 40 hours weekly
Remote
Selection Process

The selection process includes a video interview screening, followed by role-specific discussions (possible assessment) and a final leadership conversation.

Commitment to Inclusion

UN/COMMON is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive and bring their full selves to work.

About UN/COMMON

UN/COMMON has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing private companies in America, reflecting our people-driven approach to growth, innovation, and excellence.

Agency Policy

Recruiting agencies are not authorized to submit candidates for this role. UN/COMMON does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from agencies.

Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4)


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi-agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesise complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Employment Type

Fixed Term - Full Time

Location

Brazil

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You'll Work With


You'll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team's immediate gap. 

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don't just own features, you take long-term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we'll transition from the general pool to a team-matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges. 

Strategic areas you may influence include:

  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a "single source of truth" for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi-currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company-wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.

The Problems You'll Solve


As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long-term technical health and success of your business unit. You'll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross-functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You'll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.

About You

  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS). 
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long-term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high-level technical leadership.

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email. 
  • Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details.
  • For information on our data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.
